task_specification.objective: Produce exactly two bounded tasks that repair authored-arena spatial integrity and presentation readability: preserve the cemetery package, restore automatic lantern audio causality, and replace text-stacked choices with authored visual hierarchy and truthful focused deltas.

diagnosis.root_cause: The authored-arena defect remains a spatial integration mismatch: near the mausoleum, camera evidence reports Warden visibility 0.333 and MausoleumCollision as an occluder. Separately, the automatic lantern path reaches combat state without a recognizable Effects-bus report. The current iteration also lacks a concrete visual-hierarchy repair for text-stacked upgrade choices.

stop_conditions: Do not expand into deferred dense-run native qualification or unrelated backlog gaps.
Stop after candidate implementation and focused self-checks; host/Tester own runtime recapture, formal verdicts, and issue closure.
Do not replace the preserved authored cemetery package, Warden presentation hierarchy, weapon resources, or retained source recordings absent explicit package-incompatibility evidence.

strategy.rationale: Use a spatial binding audit for the arena defect instead of more camera-offset tuning. Group the remaining presentation work into one bounded presentation-contract task with separately retestable audio and upgrade-choice sub-surfaces, preserving authoritative data and UI seams.

code: Run focused parser/resource-load checks for modified world, collision/navigation, weapon, audio, and upgrade UI bindings; verify no runtime errors, duplicate audio owners, or stale placeholder stat rows.

White-box inspect authored-map anchors, camera-query masks, attack authorization signals, Effects voices, semantic stems, upgrade eligibility filtering, truthful current/new values, and focus-state bindings.
runtime: Host/Tester recapture MCP states for spawn, mausoleum approach, near-contact, departure, perimeter traversal, one SEMI click, and one quick AUTO tap with runtime logs and source-event/audio timelines.

Run native_godot_project and host_godot_boot preservation checks; verify ordinary movement, collision sliding, landmark visibility, spawn fairness, attack cadence, release/reset lifecycle, Effects audibility, and interactive upgrade choice behavior.
Tester owns formal reruns of both required release-convergence contracts and issue-ledger closure.
visual: Capture shipped-gameplay views at spawn, critical mausoleum route, central landmark, and perimeter to verify larger scale, external depth, landmark visibility, collision alignment, player framing, and no disappearance/occlusion drift.
Capture adjacent SEMI/AUTO onset, impact, and recovery frames paired with distinct runtime state/time and one event each.

Capture the level-up draft over gameplay and pause backdrops at native viewport and supported UI scale; verify icon-led hierarchy, at most three truthful deltas, restrained copy, and complete keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus states.

done_when: The playable route has larger traversable scale (expand the route where required) around the authored central building/landmark without replacing or duplicating the intact map.
The external world and external depth remain visible from spawn, critical route, landmark approach, and perimeter; no disappearance or occlusion occurs during ordinary movement/movement replay.
Central landmark collision aligns with its visible footprint; the player and representative enemies cannot pass through it, and the perimeter/boundary remains coherent.
The shipped high-angle camera keeps Warden, nearby threats, escape lanes, and the landmark readable before approach, at near contact, and after departure.
Tester can replay spawn → central landmark → perimeter and inspect collision, visibility, navigation, spawn safety, and boundary predicates.
tasks.instructions: Repair traversal integration around the preserved authored cemetery package. Audit native streets, the central building/landmark footprint, StaticBody3D shapes, camera-query layers, navigation, spawn/objective anchors, and camera framing as one binding. Prefer direct instance restoration or wrapper/binding isolation over another transform-only tweak. Keep the authored package as the sole visual environment; add only product-owned collision, navigation, spawn, objective, or gameplay-boundary anchors when needed. Ensure larger traversable scale, coherent external world/external depth, aligned central landmark collision, deterministic spawn-safe lanes, and stable perimeter/boundary visibility during ordinary movement/movement replay. Isolate proxy/support geometry that causes disappearance or occlusion while leaving native streets, landmarks, materials, and hierarchy intact.
tasks.title: Restore authored arena scale, landmark collision, and occlusion-safe traversal

done_when: One SEMI click and one quick AUTO tap each produce exactly one bounded, recognizable lantern transient on Effects, with onset and duration distinguishable from impact or ambience.

Attack audio remains causally tied to cadence and target result; miss, concrete-hit, metal-hit, and character-hit stems are separately identifiable, with no duplicate complete player recording from generic VFX.
Sustained AUTO starts only after cadence-valid continuation, stops on release, and resets on lifecycle restart/death; no duplicate or lingering voices remain.

If an independent same-bus control is silent, the candidate repair addresses the Effects route/collector/settings path rather than rewriting source content; if it is live, the proven lantern adapter or voice binding is repaired. Unreliable world-surface impact audio is attenuated or disabled while compact impact VFX and character-hit feedback remain.

Upgrade and weapon choices lead with authored silhouettes or icons, use compact stat icons, show truthful aligned current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant deltas, omit unchanged/zero-placeholder/locked/incompatible/unrelated rows, and provide distinct keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus, hover, selected, and unavailable states without changing card dimensions.
tasks.instructions: Implement one bounded presentation-contract pass covering two independently retestable surfaces. First, trace AttackRuntime → WardenLanternRuntime → MournlightAudioDirector → Effects, establish an independent same-bus positive control, and repair the proven adapter, voice binding, bus/collector/settings route, envelope, level, or lifecycle gate. Preserve the authored Warden hierarchy, animation profile, weapon resources, retained component/source recordings, and singular player-report ownership; do not add generated tones or duplicate full shot playback. Second, replace text-stacked upgrade/weapon choices with authored silhouettes or icons leading each option, compact stat icons, aligned truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas, restrained consequence copy, and complete keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus states. Keep both implementations in their existing authoritative data/UI seams so audio and choice behavior can be black-box and white-box retested separately.
